title: SystemFuelFlowDTO
description: SystemFuelFlowDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

systemFuelFlowUOMCode.description: Code used to identify the fuel flow units of measure.

maximumFuelFlowRateSourceCode.description: Code used to identify the source of maximum fuel flow.

beginDate.description: Date on which information became effective or activity started.

beginHour.description: Hour in which information became effective.

endDate.description: Last date in which information was effective.  This date will be null for active records.

endHour.description: Last hour in which information was effective or hour in which activity ended. This value will be null for active records.

id.description: Unique identifier of a system fuel flow record.

monitoringSystemRecordId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring system record.

fuelCode.description: The type of fuel measured by the system.

systemTypeCode.description: Code used to identify the type (parameter) of the system.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.

active.description: Flag for active monitor location record
